card.name: The word carbon in chemical terms
card.fires_on: The word carbon (also copper, ribbon) when it is the first part of a compound term such as carbon dioxide, carbon monoxide or hydrocarbon. It also fires on carbon used in other phrases.

modes.label: Carbon compounds
modes.description: Carbon or hydrocarbon as the first part of a chemical name, with dioxide, monoxide or anesthetics to follow.

modes.label: Other element or noun
modes.description: Copper or ribbon at the start of a phrase, in a similar position before a continuing term.
